title: TrustSignal
description: A single dynamic, evidence-based signal about how much to trust an actor for one action. Multiple signal types are NEVER collapsed into one number — model confidence and org trust always stay separate signal records.

actionRequestId.description: Optional link to the Event this signal was computed for

signalType.description: MODEL_CONFIDENCE = the AI's own certainty. ORG_TRUST_SCORE = org's learned trust in this actor over time. These must never be merged into a single value.

value.description: 0-1 normalized score. For ANOMALY_FLAG, 1 = anomaly detected, 0 = none.
